what: The center line of the Hero film (a shader video slot where beams of light from the center slowly circle between four colors) is pushed away from the mouse’s horizontal position — the target offset (x/width·2−1)·−.2 is followed each frame by .1 of the remaining distance, applied as a parabola that is 0 at the top and bottom ends and 1 in the middle, so the film seems to bend and flow sideways. The two screen edges are pinned with smoothstep.

options.amount: Shift when the mouse is at the screen edge (uv), default .2
options.speed: Speed of the film light streaks turning, default 1
options.--fx-film-1: Film colors 1~4 (--fx-film-2·3·4), default accent · light accent · surface · dark text color

use: — three.cjs is loaded between scroll-sag-warp/three-pre.js and three-post.js
note: The original takes the video (home-hero) as a VideoTexture and pushes it the same way — the original video is not used, a light-beam shader of the same ratio fills the slot. On touch screens it does not push like the original, only the film turns.
